finding: Supabase CLI renders an empty migration-list cell as backtick-space-backtick. Trimming before stripping backticks leaves a single space after delimiter removal, which is truthy and was falsely classified as remote-only drift.
rule: Normalize provider CLI table cells to semantic values: trim whitespace, remove presentation delimiters, then trim again before identity comparison.
prevention: normalize cells with trim -> strip surrounding backticks -> trim
apply identical normalization to pre-repair and post-repair parsers
regression-test the exact backtick-space-backtick empty-cell representation
remain fail-closed on any real remote-only or unexpected identity drift
